units.source_text: 胧月夜闻知前和泉守的传言，想道：

en.t: Oborozukiyo heard what the former Governor of Izumi had said and thought:

units.source_text: “这又何必呢！

en.t: Why should there be any need for this?

units.source_text: 世事我都看穿了。

en.t: I have seen through everything in this world.

units.source_text: 自昔我就痛恨他的薄情，直到现在。

en.t: From long ago until now, I have bitterly resented his heartlessness.

units.source_text: 我岂能撇开了和上皇离别的悲哀而同他畅叙旧情呢？

en.t: How could I set aside the sorrow of parting from the Retired Emperor and freely reminisce with him about old times?

units.source_text: 事情固然不会泄露出去，但‘心若问时’，叫我多么可耻！”

en.t: The matter may never become known, but if my own heart were to question me, how shameful it would be!

units.source_text: 言下不胜慨叹。

en.t: As she said this, she could not help sighing deeply.

units.source_text: 前和泉守只得把拒绝会面的消息禀复源氏。

en.t: The former Governor of Izumi had no choice but to report to Genji that she refused to meet him.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：

en.t: Genji thought:

units.source_text: “从前唐突无理之事，她并不曾拒绝我呢。

en.t: In the past, even when I acted abruptly and unreasonably, she did not refuse me.

units.source_text: 固然她有和上皇离别的悲哀，但她对我并非没有关系，现在却装作清清白白的样子。

en.t: It is true that she is grieving over parting from the Retired Emperor, but she is not unrelated to me, and now she pretends to be perfectly innocent.

units.source_text: 须知‘艳名广播如飞鸟’，如今又岂能挽回呢？”

en.t: She ought to know that a romantic reputation spreads like a flying bird; how could it be undone now?

units.source_text: 他就下个决心，以这“信田森”为向导而前往访问。

en.t: He then made up his mind and set out to visit her, using this Shinoda Forest as his guide.

units.source_text: 事前对紫姬说：

en.t: Beforehand, he said to Lady Murasaki:

units.source_text: “二条院东院那位常陆小姐病得很长久了。

en.t: The Hitachi lady in the eastern wing of the Nijo residence has been ill for a very long time.

units.source_text: 我因杂务缠身，至今尚未前去望病，很对她不起。

en.t: Because I have been tied down by many duties, I still have not gone to visit her in her illness, and I feel very sorry toward her.

units.source_text: 白昼公然出门，似乎不甚稳便，拟于夜间悄悄前往。

en.t: Going out openly in daylight would not seem quite proper, so I plan to go quietly at night.

units.source_text: 我想勿使外人知道。”

en.t: I would like to keep outsiders from knowing about it.

units.source_text: 便用心打扮，妆饰非常讲究。

en.t: He then dressed with great care, taking extraordinary pains with his appearance.

units.source_text: 紫姬记得他以前去访末摘花时，从来不曾如此用心打扮，看到今天这模样，觉得有点奇怪。

en.t: Lady Murasaki remembered that when he had visited Suetsumuhana before, he had never taken such care with his dress, and seeing him like this today, she found it somewhat strange.

units.source_text: 她已经猜到了几分。

en.t: She had already guessed something of the truth.

units.source_text: 然而自从三公主入院以后，她对付源氏，万事皆与从前大不相同，都有了几分隔阂，所以只装作不知。

en.t: However, ever since the Third Princess had entered the residence, her way of dealing with Genji had become very different from before in every respect, and a certain distance had grown between them, so she merely pretended not to know.
